description: Build a structured 30-day habit plan from a proven habit framework that fits the daily time budget (habits longer than the remaining minutes are left out and listed), phased in week by week with check-in days. Optionally aligns each week with the numerology personal month if a birth date is given.

birth_date.description: Optional date of birth YYYY-MM-DD to add the numerology personal month theme

goal.description: discipline, energy, character, consistency or focus

minutes_per_day.description: Time available per day in minutes

start_date.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD; defaults to today (UTC) if the user did not name a date

name: build_habit_stack
title: Habit Stack Planner
